text: いつもの　なかまと　つうしんも　いいが…　たまには　ユニオンルームへ　いって　みては　どうかな？

structure.jp: いつもの　なかまと　つうしんも　いいが…
structure.en: linking with your usual friends is fine too, but...

structure.jp: ユニオンルームへ　いって　みては
structure.en: trying going to the Union Room

patterns.name: 〜てはどうか
patterns.span: いって　みては　どうかな
patterns.explanation: A て-form verb with は どうか is a polite way to suggest something: 'how about doing it?'. いって　みては　どうかな = 'how about trying going there?'.

patterns.name: 〜てみる
patterns.explanation: みる after a て-form verb means doing something to see what it is like. いって　みて = 'try going'.

patterns.name: 〜が (but)
patterns.explanation: が at the end of a phrase means 'but'. いいが = 'it's fine, but'.
